abstract:
M2 macrophages enriched in endometriotic lesions are involved in immune evasion and angiogenesis, while the migratory capacity of ectopic endometrial stromal cells is also closely associated with lesion progression. However, whether these two processes are regulated by a common upstream molecule remains unclear. This study aims to investigate whether endometrial stromal cell-derived miR-423-5p promotes M2 macrophage polarization by targeting epithelial membrane protein 2 (EMP2) and directly enhances the migratory capacity of stromal cells themselves, thereby synergistically contributing to the progression of endometriosis (EMs).
The EMs-related dataset GSE7305 was downloaded from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. The dataset included ectopic endometrial tissues from 9 patients with EMs and endometrial tissues from 7 women without EMs, and the infiltration of 22 immune cell types was evaluated and compared. Ectopic and eutopic endometrial tissues were collected from 10 patients with EMs, respectively. The expression levels of miR-423-5p, EMP2, and the M2 markers CD206 and IL-10 were examined by immunohistochemical staining, reverse transcription PCR (RT-PCR), and Western blotting. A dual-luciferase reporter assay was performed to verify the direct binding of miR-423-5p to the 3'- untranslated region (3'-UTR) of EMP2. THP-1 cells were induced to differentiate into M2 macrophages in vitro and were transfected with miR-423-5p mimics, mimic negative control (NC), miR-423-5p inhibitor, or inhibitor NC. Meanwhile, primary human endometrial stromal cells (phESCs) were isolated and cultured, transfected, and subsequently co-cultured with M2 macrophages. The expression levels of miR-423-5p, EMP2, CD206, and IL-10 were assessed by RT-PCR and Western blotting. A wound-healing assay was used to assess the migratory capacity of endometrial stromal cells.
Bioinformatics analysis showed that the proportion of M2 macrophages was significantly higher in ectopic endometrial tissues than in normal endometrial tissues (P<0.05). Immunohistochemical staining, RT-PCR, and Western blotting consistently showed that the expression levels of the M2 markers CD206 and IL-10 were significantly higher in ectopic endometrial tissues from patients with EMs than in their eutopic endometrial tissues, whereas EMP2 expression was significantly lower in ectopic than in eutopic endometrium (all P<0.05). RT-PCR showed that miR-423-5p expression was significantly higher in phESCs derived from ectopic endometrium than in those derived from eutopic endometrium (P<0.05). The dual-luciferase reporter assay demonstrated that miR-423-5p directly bound to the 3'-UTR of EMP2 and suppressed its activity (P<0.05). Overexpression of miR-423-5p in M2 macrophages significantly upregulated CD206 and IL-10 expression and downregulated EMP2 expression (all P<0.05), whereas inhibition of miR-423-5p produced the opposite effects. Co-culture experiments further demonstrated that stromal cells overexpressing miR-423-5p promoted M2 macrophage polarization and downregulated EMP2 expression in the co-culture system (all P<0.05). The wound-healing assay showed that upregulation of miR-423-5p significantly enhanced the migratory capacity of endometrial stromal cells (P<0.05).
Endometrial stromal cells may promote M2 macrophage polarization by secreting miR-423-5p and thereby targeting and downregulating EMP2 expression in M2 macrophages, while simultaneously enhancing their own migratory capacity. Together, these effects may contribute to remodeling of the immune microenvironment and progression of EMs.

子宫内膜异位症(endometriosis，EMs)病灶中富集的M2型巨噬细胞参与免疫逃逸及血管生成，异位内膜间质细胞的迁移能力亦与病灶进展密切相关，但二者是否受同一上游分子调控尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨子宫内膜间质细胞来源的miR-423-5p是否通过靶向上皮膜蛋白2(epithelial membrane protein 2，EMP2)促进巨噬细胞的M2型极化，并直接增强间质细胞自身迁移能力，从而协同参与EMs病灶进展。方法: 从基因表达综合数据库(Gene Expression Omnibus，GEO)下载EMs相关数据集GSE7305，其中包括9例EMs异位子宫内膜及7例无EMs女性的正常子宫内膜组织，评估并比较22种免疫细胞的免疫浸润情况。收集EMs患者异位与在位内膜组织各10例，通过免疫组织化学染色、反转录PCR(reverse transcription PCR，RT-PCR)、蛋白质印迹法检测miR-423-5p、EMP2及M2型标志物的表达。采用双萤光素酶报告基因实验验证miR-423-5p与EMP2 3'-非翻译区(untranslated region，UTR)的直接靶向结合。体外诱导THP-1细胞分化为M2型巨噬细胞，分别转染miR-423-5p mimics、mimics阴性对照(mimics NC)、miR-423-5p inhibitor、inhibitor阴性对照(inhibitor NC);同时，分离并培养原代人子宫内膜间质细胞(primary human endometrial stromal cells，phESCs)，转染后与M2型巨噬细胞共培养;采用RT-PCR、蛋白质印迹法检测miR-423-5p、EMP2、CD206及白细胞介素(interleukin，IL)-10的表达;采用划痕愈合实验检测phESCs的迁移能力。结果: 生物信息学分析结果显示，异位子宫内膜组织中M2型巨噬细胞的比例显著高于正常子宫内膜组织(P<0.05)。免疫组织化学染色及RT-PCR、蛋白质印迹法结果均显示，EMs患者异位子宫内膜组织中M2型标志物CD206和IL-10的表达水平均显著高于患者的在位子宫内膜，同时EMP2的表达水平显著低于在位子宫内膜(均P<0.05)。RT-PCR检测结果显示，异位内膜来源的phESCs中miR-423-5p的表达水平显著高于在位内膜来源的phESCs(P<0.05)。双萤光素酶实验结果显示，miR-423-5p可直接结合EMP2的3'-UTR并抑制其活性(P<0.05)。在M2型巨噬细胞中过表达miR-423-5p能显著上调CD206和IL-10的表达水平，并下调EMP2的表达水平(均P<0.05);抑制miR-423-5p则产生相反作用。共培养实验进一步证实，过表达miR-423-5p的间质细胞可促进共培养体系中巨噬细胞的M2型极化并下调EMP2的表达(均P<0.05)。划痕愈合实验显示，上调miR-423-5p表达可显著增强phESCs的迁移能力(P<0.05)。结论: 子宫内膜间质细胞可能通过分泌miR-423-5p，靶向下调巨噬细胞中EMP2的表达，从而驱动其向M2型极化，同时增强自身的迁移能力，两者共同参与EMs免疫微环境的重塑与病情的进展。.M2 macrophagecell migrationendometrial stromal cellsendometriosisepithelial membrane protein
